messages:
maya: quick design check — thinking about the rerank table + embeddings preview for batch imports. idea: show an inline 'delta' column (score vs baseline) so users can scan what changed without opening details. thoughts?
jon: like it. call it 'Δ relevance' or just 'Delta' with tooltip. short label helps table density. :+1:
sam: agree on short label. tooltip copy: "Change vs baseline model (positive = more relevant)". also we should surface whether higher is better.
kai: small accessibility nit — if the column sorts, we need aria-sort updates and a live region announcement when order changes. screen reader users should hear "sorted by Delta, descending".
maya: good call. also UX question: where does export fit? current mock shows export in row menu and top-right bulk export. i'm leaning toward keeping bulk export top-right and row export in kebab for single-row CSV.
aria: can we standardize the CSV columns? proposal: `id, text_preview, vector_dim, score, baseline_score, delta, neighbor_ids`. that makes downstream tooling easier.
luis: performance note — exporting neighbor_ids for huge batches will blow up sizes. maybe truncate neighbors to top 10 or add a toggle for full neighbors.
jon: for previewing vectors in the row inspector, instead of raw floats, show a small sparkline + top terms from a k-NN explainability call. less intimidating than long arrays.
sam: copy tweak for empty-state when rerank yields no changes: "No reranking differences found — try widening your candidate set or lowering similarity threshold." keeps actionable guidance.
kai: keyboard nav: rows need to be focusable with arrow keys and Enter to open inspector. also provide `r` shortcut to toggle rerank mode.
maya: design question — should the Delta column use color encoding? green red gradient? i worry about color-only cues.
aria: use color + icon (+/−) and tooltip. that covers colorblind users. also include an accessible text label in the DOM (visually-hidden) like "Delta +0.12".
luis: staging heads-up: if batch size > 2k we should disable neighbor explainability by default to avoid N+1 explain calls. fallback to async job with progress.
jon: agreed. UI needs a small progress indicator for background explain jobs and an email/webhook when ready.
maya: tiny microcopy nit for the preview header: current "Vectors" -> change to "Embeddings preview" (more explicit).
aria: that matches other console wording. also update analytics event names when we change.
deploy-bot: design-preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.dev/design/rerank-batch-ux 
sam: quick QA: the export CSV example should include a header row. we should show a sample modal before export for large batches with estimated size and time to prepare.
maya: excellent. i'll update the mock: - add Delta column label + tooltip - aria-live for sort changes - sparkline + k-NN top terms in preview - export modal for large batches - truncate neighbors by default and add toggle. i'll push a new figma frame and ping y'all when ready. :rocket:
jon: thanks — small followup: change sort icon hit area to 40px for mobile/tablet.
maya: noted. will include.
aria: all set from copy perspective, ping me for final text.
luís: once we land this, we should run a quick perf eval on a 10k document batch.
maya: yep — adding perf test to the ticket.
jon: :thumbsup:
